description: Land Acquisition - Ganemulla, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha District and Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 200/54 of 05.01.2017 and other 4 Amendments
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land lots (33 parcels) with descriptions of each property, including land names, types (paddy fields, canals, gardens), claimants, and extents. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" including "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" as specified in the Land Gazettes (Type 4) classification.
